public_body: Worcester Public Schools Strategic Planning Committee
overall: The AG found the Strategic Planning Committee is not a public body under the Open Meeting Law because it is private, not "within" government, so the complaint was resolved with no violation and no orders.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Worcester Public Schools Strategic Planning Committee is a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: Because the Committee is not "within" government, we conclude that it is not a public body subject to the requirements of the Open Meeting Law

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the Committee failed to comply with Open Meeting Law requirements; the AG did not reach compliance once it found the Committee not covered.
allegations.key_passage: it was created by private groups and its members were chosen by those groups. It has not been given any authority by the School Committee, nor does it use school resources.
